NucPhys is the Erasmus Mundus master in nuclear physics delivered by a Spanish-led consortium including the universities of Sevilla, Barcelona, UCM Madrid, Salamanca and European partners such as Université Paris-Saclay and TU Darmstadt. The next application round is expected to close in mid-December 2026, in line with recent cycles.

Programme Highlights

  • Specialised two-year nuclear physics master with lab and research placements
  • Application rounds historically close in mid-December for the following September
  • Consortium includes leading European nuclear-physics facilities
  • Graduates proceed to doctoral research and detector/instrumentation careers

Who Should Apply

Physics graduates with nuclear or particle physics coursework are the target group; English documentation follows the consortium's checklist.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students: participation costs covered plus a monthly allowance.

Deadline and How to Apply

Check the application-procedure page on the NucPhys site for the exact December cut-off and submit through the online form. Key deadline information: Mid-December 2026 (expected) — confirm the exact date on the official application-procedure page.
